status: draft, to be curated; texts of the report. {name} are placeholders filled by the report generator

outcomes.owner_access_lost: An owner loses all access to the main funds

exploit.immediate: an attacker can act at once
exploit.at_use: an attacker can act when the funds are used

exploit.after_delay: an attacker can act once the delay of that policy has passed

likelihood.category_default: Base {base}: no estimate for this threat yet, default of its category. To be reviewed.

vulnerability.worst: Rated for the worst outcome, on wallet {wallet}.

note.no_response: it does not count because nothing answers a detection in time

vulnerability.travel_alone: , cannot be done by that person alone

risk.result: Likelihood {L} + vulnerability {V} - 4 gives the residual likelihood {RL}; with severity {S} the risk matrix gives {R} ({label}).

needs_input.detection_without_response: A detecting measure exists, but no recovery action answers it: say whether someone would react.
needs_input.likelihood_default: The likelihood is a category default: review it.

not_applicable.applies_when: The threat does not apply to this kind of entity.
